The wrapper only calls the common helper. Its six independent reference comparisons and source-player reset do not touch arrow-local xE0 or xC4. No framework-wide lifetime guarantee is inferred.

The held callback maintains scale and checks lifetime only for a matching owner; a non-null mismatch returns false. Native fighter callers supply geometry, and the copied-bow predicate distinguishes the two copied motion families.
